normal.en: Stress the first syllable: AR-tist.
normal.cn: 重音在第一个音节：AR-tist。

abstract.en: See a brush held loosely between fingers.
abstract.cn: 想象手指间松松握着画笔。

abstract.en: See a stage lit from below.
abstract.cn: 想象被下方灯光照亮的舞台。

abstract.en: See a hand steadying a small sculpture.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手稳住小雕像。

examples.en: The artist worked standing up for six hours.
examples.cn: 这位画家站着画了六个小时。

examples.en: The artist came back for a second song.
examples.cn: 这位歌手返场又唱了一首。

examples.en: He is an artist at finding cheap flights.
examples.cn: 他找便宜机票是个高手。

dict_mnemonic.text: art（艺术）加 -ist（人）：从事艺术的人，就是艺术家。

root: 经法语 artiste 与意大利语 artista 来自拉丁语 ars「技艺」；由「有技艺之人」窄化为造型艺术家，又扩展到表演者与能手。

sensesIntro.en: Skill in making, skill on stage, and skill anywhere share one word.
sensesIntro.cn: 制作中的技艺、舞台上的技艺、任何行当的技艺，共用同一个词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand holding a brush above wet paint.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手握着笔停在未干的颜料上。

intro.en: A French and Italian word built on the Latin root for skill.
intro.cn: 这是一个经法语与意大利语构成、以拉丁语「技艺」为根的词。

latinIntro.en: The root ars also gives art, artifice, and artisan.
latinIntro.cn: 词根 ars 也派生出 art、artifice 与 artisan。

definition_zh: 艺术的；有艺术才华的；有审美品味的
definition_en: relating to art, or showing natural skill and taste in art
core_image: 眼睛先在心里构图，再动手
scene: 房间的摆设并不贵，却处处有讲究。The whole room has an artistic feel.
sceneCN: 这里 artistic 是「有艺术气息的」（第 2 个义项：显出艺术才华与品味）；句意是整个房间有一种艺术气息。

pos.zh: 形容词：艺术的；有艺术才华的

senses.title: Relating to art
senses.definition: connected with art or with artists
senses.definitionCN: 与艺术或艺术家相关的
senses.example: The city has a strong artistic tradition.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市有深厚的艺术传统。
senses.why: Artist plus -ic makes an adjective of belonging: whatever belongs to artists or their work is artistic.
senses.whyCN: artist 加 -ic 构成表示归属的形容词：属于艺术家或其作品的东西就是「艺术的」。

senses.title: Showing artistic gift
senses.definition: naturally good at making or judging beautiful things
senses.definitionCN: 天生擅长创作或鉴赏美的事物
senses.example: The whole room has an artistic feel.
senses.exampleCN: 整个房间有一种艺术气息。
senses.why: The same adjective shifts from belonging to possessing: a person or place can show the quality itself.
senses.whyCN: 同一个形容词从「属于」转向「具有」：人或场所本身可以显出这种品质。

intro.en: Artistic is a modern adjective formed on artist.
intro.cn: artistic 是在 artist 之上构成的近代形容词。

items.en: ars meant 'skill, craft'.
items.cn: ars 意为「技艺、手艺」。

items.en: artista named a skilled maker.
items.cn: artista 指有技艺的制作者。

items.en: English artist settled in the sixteenth century.
items.cn: 英语 artist 在十六世纪定型。

items.en: The adjective artistic appeared with the rise of art criticism.
items.cn: 随着艺术批评兴起，形容词 artistic 出现。

items.en: It now describes both art itself and people with taste.
items.cn: 如今它既修饰艺术本身，也形容有品味的人。

note.en: The look-alike group is the artist family; the near-meaning group gives words of taste and beauty.
note.cn: 形近组是 artist 词族；近义组是表示品味与美的词。

normalIntro.en: Artistic means either of art or full of art.
normalIntro.cn: artistic 既可以指「属于艺术」，也可以指「充满艺术感」。

normal.en: Artistic director is a real job title.
normal.cn: artistic director 是真实的职位名称。

normal.en: Artistic merit judges a work's value.
normal.cn: artistic merit 用来评判作品的价值。

normal.en: The adverb adds -ally, not -ly.
normal.cn: 副词加的是 -ally，而非 -ly。

normal.en: Do not confuse it with autistic.
normal.cn: 注意不要与 autistic 混淆。

normal.en: Stress the middle syllable: ar-TIS-tic.
normal.cn: 重音在中间音节：ar-TIS-tic。

abstract.en: See a hand framing a view before drawing it.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手在取景后再落笔。

abstract.en: See a plain room made lovely by one vase.
abstract.cn: 想象素净的房间因一只花瓶而变美。

abstract.en: See paint marks left deliberately rough.
abstract.cn: 想象故意留下的粗粝笔触。

examples.en: The city has a strong artistic tradition.
examples.cn: 这座城市有深厚的艺术传统。

examples.en: The whole room has an artistic feel.
examples.cn: 整个房间有一种艺术气息。

examples.en: She comes from a very artistic family.
examples.cn: 她出身于一个很有艺术氛围的家庭。

dict_mnemonic.text: artist（艺术家）加 -ic：与艺术家或艺术相关的，就是艺术的。

root: 由 artist 加形容词后缀 -ic 构成；artist 经法语与意大利语源自拉丁语 ars「技艺」。

sensesIntro.en: Belonging to art and possessing art are two sides of one adjective.
sensesIntro.cn: 「属于艺术」与「富有艺术感」是同一个形容词的两面。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an eye composing a picture before the hand begins.
core.cn: 核心意象：动手之前，眼睛已在心里构图。

intro.en: A nineteenth-century adjective grown from the noun artist.
intro.cn: 这是一个由名词 artist 长出的十九世纪形容词。

latinIntro.en: The root ars, 'skill', underlies the whole family.
latinIntro.cn: 词根 ars「技艺」支撑着整个词族。

definition_zh: 在艺术方面；有艺术性地
definition_en: in a way that relates to art, or with artistic skill
core_image: 从审美的角度去看待一件事
scene: 评审团围着一张照片讨论了很久。The film is artistically ambitious but slow.
sceneCN: 这里 artistically 是「在艺术方面」（第 1 个义项：从艺术的角度衡量）；句意是这部影片在艺术上有野心，但节奏缓慢。

pos.zh: 副词：在艺术上；有艺术性地

senses.title: From an artistic point of view
senses.definition: judged by the standards of art rather than profit or speed
senses.definitionCN: 以艺术标准而非利润或速度来评判
senses.example: The film is artistically ambitious but slow.
senses.exampleCN: 这部影片在艺术上有野心，但节奏缓慢。
senses.why: The adverb marks the angle from which something is judged; adding -ly to artistic sets that angle as art.
senses.whyCN: 副词标出评判的角度；artistic 加 -ly 就把这一角度定为「艺术」。

senses.title: With artistic skill
senses.definition: done in a way that shows trained taste or craft
senses.definitionCN: 以显出训练有素的品味或手艺的方式完成
senses.example: The room was artistically lit for the evening.
senses.exampleCN: 房间为晚会打上了富有艺术感的光。
senses.why: The same adverb can describe the manner of the doing, not just the standpoint of the judge.
senses.whyCN: 同一个副词也能描述做法本身的方式，而不只是评判者的立场。

intro.en: Artistically is artistic with the adverb ending -ally.
intro.cn: artistically 就是 artistic 加上副词后缀 -ally。

items.en: ars meant 'skill, craft'.
items.cn: ars 意为「技艺」。

items.en: artist named a skilled maker.
items.cn: artist 指有技艺的制作者。

items.en: artistic described what belongs to art.
items.cn: artistic 描述属于艺术的事物。

items.en: The adverb appeared in art criticism.
items.cn: 这个副词出现在艺术批评文字中。

items.en: It now marks both judgment and manner.
items.cn: 如今它既标出评判角度，也标出做法方式。

note.en: The look-alike group is the same adjective; the near-meaning group gives other adverbs of aesthetic judgment.
note.cn: 形近组是同一形容词的变形；近义组是其他表示审美判断的副词。

normalIntro.en: Artistically tells you the yardstick is art.
normalIntro.cn: artistically 说明所用的尺子是艺术。

normal.en: It usually modifies adjectives such as gifted or ambitious.
normal.cn: 它常修饰 gifted、ambitious 这类形容词。

normal.en: The ending is -ally because the adjective ends in -ic.
normal.cn: 因形容词以 -ic 结尾，副词形式加 -ally。

normal.en: It can also describe how something is done.
normal.cn: 它也能描述某事如何完成。

normal.en: It contrasts with commercially or technically.
normal.cn: 它常与 commercially 或 technically 相对。

normal.en: Stress the second syllable: ar-TIS-ti-cal-ly.
normal.cn: 重音在第二个音节：ar-TIS-ti-cal-ly。

abstract.en: See a judge holding a work at arm's length.
abstract.cn: 想象评判者把作品举远端详。

abstract.en: See a lamp angled to flatter a wall.
abstract.cn: 想象灯以妙角度照亮墙面。

abstract.en: See a hand choosing one colour out of many.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手从众多颜色中挑出一种。

examples.en: The film is artistically ambitious but slow.
examples.cn: 这部影片在艺术上有野心，但节奏缓慢。

examples.en: The room was artistically lit for the evening.
examples.cn: 房间为晚会打上了富有艺术感的光。

examples.en: The two brothers are both artistically gifted.
examples.cn: 兄弟俩都有艺术天赋。

dict_mnemonic.text: artistic（艺术的）加 -ally：以艺术的方式或角度，就是「在艺术上」。

root: 由形容词 artistic 加副词后缀 -ally 构成；artistic 来自 artist，最终源自拉丁语 ars「技艺」。

sensesIntro.en: One adverb marks the angle of judgment and the manner of making.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一个副词既标评判的角度，也标制作的方式。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a work held up and judged by one standard.
core.cn: 核心意象：作品被举起，以某一种标准衡量。

intro.en: A regular adverb built on the adjective artistic.
intro.cn: 这是一个在形容词 artistic 上规则构成的副词。

latinIntro.en: The whole family returns to the Latin root ars, 'skill'.
latinIntro.cn: 整个词族都可回溯到拉丁语词根 ars「技艺」。

definition_en: used to show a role, a comparison, a point in time, or a reason
core_image: 一条线把两件事并排连起来
scene: 她在医院里穿着白衣，走过长廊。She works as a nurse in the city.
sceneCN: 这里 as 是「作为」（第 1 个义项：表示身份或角色）；句意是她在城里当护士。

derivatives.zh: 副词：也，与 as 同出一个古英语复合词

senses.title: In the role of
senses.definition: used to name the job or function of someone
senses.definitionCN: 用来指明某人的职业或功能
senses.example: She works as a nurse in the city.
senses.exampleCN: 她在城里当护士。
senses.why: Old English alswa meant 'all so, just so'; from 'in that way' came the sense 'in the capacity of'.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 alswa 意为「正如此、就这样」；由「以那种方式」发展出「以那个身份」。

senses.title: In the same degree as
senses.definition: used to compare two things as equal
senses.definitionCN: 用来比较两件事程度相同
senses.example: He is as tall as his brother.
senses.exampleCN: 他和他哥哥一样高。
senses.why: If as means 'just so', placing it on both sides of an adjective says the two sides are just so alike.
senses.whyCN: 既然 as 意为「正是如此」，把它放在形容词两边，就是说两边同样如此。

senses.title: At the time when
senses.definition: used to introduce an action happening at the same time
senses.definitionCN: 引出与主句同时发生的动作
senses.example: As I left, the phone rang.
senses.exampleCN: 我离开的时候，电话响了。
senses.why: Two events happening 'just so' together are simultaneous, which gives the time sense.
senses.whyCN: 两件事「正好这样」同时发生，就是同时性，于是产生时间义。

senses.title: Because
senses.definition: used to give the reason for something
senses.definitionCN: 用来给出某事的原因
senses.example: As it was late, we took a taxi.
senses.exampleCN: 因为时间晚了，我们打了车。
senses.why: A circumstance that stands 'just so' alongside an act is often its cause, so as came to introduce reasons.
senses.whyCN: 与行为「正好并列」的情境往往就是它的原因，于是 as 也用来引出理由。

intro.en: As is a worn-down form of an Old English phrase meaning 'all so'.
intro.cn: as 是古英语中意为「完全如此」的短语磨损后的形式。

items.en: alswa meant 'all so, wholly so'.
items.cn: alswa 意为「完全如此」。

items.en: The word shortened to als and then as.
items.cn: 这个词缩短为 als，再变为 as。

items.en: As spread into comparisons and time clauses.
items.cn: as 扩展到比较与时间从句。

items.en: The reason sense became common in writing.
items.cn: 原因义在书面语中变得常见。

items.en: As is now one of the commonest words in English.
items.cn: 如今 as 是英语中最常用的词之一。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the old 'so' family; the near-meaning group gives words that cover single senses of as.
note.cn: 形近组同出古英语「如此」一族；近义组是分别承担 as 某一义项的词。

normalIntro.en: As points at a role, a match, a moment, or a cause.
normalIntro.cn: as 分别指向身份、相同、时刻与原因。

normal.en: As a teacher names the job.
normal.cn: as a teacher 点明职业。

normal.en: As tall as repeats the word for comparison.
normal.cn: as tall as 重复该词以作比较。

normal.en: As I left marks two things happening together.
normal.cn: as I left 表示两事同时发生。

normal.en: As can also mean because at the start of a clause.
normal.cn: 置于句首时 as 也可表示因为。

normal.en: The word is weak in speech: /əz/.
normal.cn: 口语中它读得轻：/əz/。

abstract.en: See two lines laid exactly parallel.
abstract.cn: 想象两条完全平行的线。

abstract.en: See a name tag pinned to a shirt.
abstract.cn: 想象别在衬衫上的名牌。

abstract.en: See two clocks showing the same minute.
abstract.cn: 想象两个时钟指着同一分钟。

examples.en: She works as a nurse in the city.
examples.cn: 她在城里当护士。

examples.en: As I left, the phone rang.
examples.cn: 我离开的时候，电话响了。

examples.en: As it was late, we took a taxi.
examples.cn: 因为时间晚了，我们打了车。

dict_mnemonic.text: as 的核心是「就这样」：是身份、是相同、是同时，也是原因。

root: 源自古英语 alswa「完全如此」，中古英语缩为 als 再变为 as；由「正是这样」发展出身份、比较、时间与原因四种用法。

sensesIntro.en: One small word says: in that role, to that degree, at that moment, for that reason.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个小词同时表示：以那个身份、到那个程度、在那个时刻、由于那个原因。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a line joining two things that stand level.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条线把两件并排而立的事物连起来。

intro.en: A function word with almost no derivational life of its own.
intro.cn: 这是一个功能词，本身几乎不派生新词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin element; the whole history is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 它没有拉丁成分，整段历史都属于日耳曼语。

definition_en: the grey powder left after something burns, or a tall tree with hard pale wood
core_image: 火熄之后，灶底剩下一层细白的灰
scene: 壁炉里的木柴烧了整夜，早上只剩下粉末。The fire had left a layer of ash on the stones.
sceneCN: 这里 ash 是「灰烬」（第 1 个义项：燃烧后剩下的粉末）；句意是炉火在石面上留下了一层灰。

derivatives.zh: 形容词：覆着灰的；灰似的

senses.title: Powder left by fire
senses.definition: the soft grey remains of something that has burned
senses.definitionCN: 某物燃烧后留下的松软灰色残余
senses.example: The fire had left a layer of ash on the stones.
senses.exampleCN: 炉火在石面上留下了一层灰。
senses.why: Old English asce named the burnt powder, and the word has kept that sense for a thousand years.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 asce 指燃烧后的粉末，这个词一千年来都保留着这一义。

senses.title: A tall hardwood tree
senses.definition: a tree with pale strong wood and winged seeds
senses.definitionCN: 木质浅色坚硬、结翅果的高大树木
senses.example: An old ash stands at the corner of the field.
senses.exampleCN: 田地角上立着一棵老白蜡树。
senses.why: This is a different Old English word, aesc, which happened to fall together in spelling and sound.
senses.whyCN: 这其实是另一个古英语词 aesc，只是拼写与读音后来与「灰」合流了。

intro.en: Ash joins two Old English words that came to look alike.
intro.cn: ash 合并了两个原本不同、后来形貌相近的古英语词。

items.en: asce meant 'ash, burnt powder'.
items.cn: asce 意为「灰、燃烧后的粉末」。

items.en: aesc meant 'ash tree' and also named the rune for it.
items.cn: aesc 意为「白蜡树」，也指代表它的卢恩字母。

items.en: Both words settled into the spelling asshe.
items.cn: 两个词都归入拼写 asshe。

items.en: The modern spelling ash became standard.
items.cn: 现代拼写 ash 成为标准。

items.en: The tree sense survives mainly in wood and plant names.
items.cn: 树木义主要保留在木材与植物名称中。

note.en: The look-alike group is the ash family; the near-meaning group gives other burnt remains.
note.cn: 形近组是 ash 词族；近义组是其他燃烧残余。

normalIntro.en: Ash is what fire leaves behind.
normalIntro.cn: ash 就是火留下的东西。

normal.en: The burnt sense is usually uncountable.
normal.cn: 「灰烬」义通常不可数。

normal.en: Ashes in the plural can mean a person's remains.
normal.cn: 复数 ashes 可指人的骨灰。

normal.en: The tree sense survives in ash wood.
normal.cn: 树木义保留在「白蜡木」这类说法里。

normal.en: Ash blonde describes a pale hair colour.
normal.cn: ash blonde 形容浅灰金色的头发。

normal.en: The word is one short syllable: ASH.
normal.cn: 这个词只有一个短音节：ASH。

abstract.en: See grey flakes settling in a fireplace.
abstract.cn: 想象灰色薄片落在壁炉里。

abstract.en: See a pale trunk with winged seeds.
abstract.cn: 想象浅色树干与翅果。

abstract.en: See a cigarette tip drop grey dust.
abstract.cn: 想象烟头落下灰色粉末。

examples.en: The fire had left a layer of ash on the stones.
examples.cn: 炉火在石面上留下了一层灰。

examples.en: An old ash stands at the corner of the field.
examples.cn: 田地角上立着一棵老白蜡树。

examples.en: Volcanic ash covered the roofs of the village.
examples.cn: 火山灰盖住了村子的屋顶。

dict_mnemonic.text: ash 有两个来源：烧完的灰，和长着浅色木头的白蜡树，拼写相同而已。

root: 一词合两源：灰烬义来自古英语 asce；白蜡树义来自古英语 aesc，兼指对应卢恩字母。二者后世同形同音。

sensesIntro.en: Fire leaves a powder, and a field may hold a tree whose name looks the same.
sensesIntro.cn: 火留下粉末，田野里也可能立着一棵名字形貌相同的树。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thin grey layer where a fire burned out.
core.cn: 核心意象：火烧尽之处留下的薄薄灰层。

intro.en: A short Germanic word with very little compounding.
intro.cn: 这是一个简短的日耳曼词，复合形式很少。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is native English.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，是英语本族词。

definition_zh: 羞愧的；惭愧的；不好意思的
definition_en: feeling shame or embarrassment about something
core_image: 低下头，不敢看别人的眼睛
scene: 他站在门口，话说到一半停住了。She felt ashamed of what she had said.
sceneCN: 这里 ashamed 是「惭愧的」（第 1 个义项：因自己的言行而感到羞耻）；句意是她为自己说过的话感到惭愧。

senses.title: Feeling shame
senses.definition: distressed by the sense that one has done wrong
senses.definitionCN: 因意识到自己做了错事而难受
senses.example: She felt ashamed of what she had said.
senses.exampleCN: 她为自己说过的话感到惭愧。
senses.why: Old English scamian meant 'to feel shame'; the a- form came to describe the person in that state.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 scamian 意为「感到羞耻」；带 a- 的形式后来用来描述处在这种状态中的人。

senses.title: Unwilling through embarrassment
senses.definition: reluctant to do something because it feels humiliating
senses.definitionCN: 因觉得难为情而不愿做某事
senses.example: He was ashamed to ask for help.
senses.exampleCN: 他不好意思开口求助。
senses.why: Shame can block an action as well as follow it, so ashamed to do is a natural extension.
senses.whyCN: 羞耻既能跟在行为之后，也能挡在行为之前，所以有「羞于去做」的用法。

intro.en: Ashamed comes from an Old English verb of feeling shame.
intro.cn: ashamed 来自一个表示「感到羞耻」的古英语动词。

items.en: scamian meant 'to feel shame'.
items.cn: scamian 意为「感到羞耻」。

items.en: The a- form meant 'to make or be ashamed'.
items.cn: 带 a- 的形式意为「使羞耻、感到羞耻」。

items.en: The past participle became an adjective.
items.cn: 过去分词转变为形容词。

items.en: Ashamed of and ashamed to were fixed patterns.
items.cn: ashamed of 与 ashamed to 成为固定搭配。

items.en: The word now describes a private feeling rather than public disgrace.
items.cn: 如今它更多描述内心的感受，而非公开的耻辱。

note.en: The look-alike group is the shame family; the near-meaning group gives other words of embarrassment and guilt.
note.cn: 形近组是 shame 词族；近义组是其他表示难堪与内疚的词。

normalIntro.en: Ashamed is the inward heat of having done wrong.
normalIntro.cn: ashamed 是做了错事之后心里发烫的感觉。

normal.en: It is almost always used after a linking verb.
normal.cn: 它几乎总是用在系动词之后。

normal.en: Ashamed of takes a thing or oneself.
normal.cn: ashamed of 后面接某件事或自己。

normal.en: Ashamed to takes a verb.
normal.cn: ashamed to 后面接动词。

normal.en: The noun is shame, not ashamedness.
normal.cn: 名词是 shame，而不是 ashamedness。

normal.en: Stress the second syllable: a-SHAMED.
normal.cn: 重音在第二个音节：a-SHAMED。

abstract.en: See eyes dropped to the floor.
abstract.cn: 想象目光垂到地面。

abstract.en: See a hand rubbing the back of a neck.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手搓着后颈。

abstract.en: See a face turned away from a window.
abstract.cn: 想象一张脸转离窗子。

examples.en: She felt ashamed of what she had said.
examples.cn: 她为自己说过的话感到惭愧。

examples.en: He was ashamed to ask for help.
examples.cn: 他不好意思开口求助。

examples.en: I am not ashamed of my accent.
examples.cn: 我不为自己的口音感到难为情。

dict_mnemonic.text: ashamed 与 shame 同族：被 shame（羞耻）占据的状态，就是「羞愧的」。

root: 源自古英语 scamian「感到羞耻」及其带 a- 的形式 ascamian，中古英语时过去分词转为形容词 ashamed。

sensesIntro.en: Shame can look back at what was done or stand in the way of what comes next.
sensesIntro.cn: 羞耻既可回望已经做过的事，也可挡在将要做的事前面。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a head lowered so the eyes cannot meet another's.
core.cn: 核心意象：低下头，使目光无法与人相接。

intro.en: An old participle that became a pure adjective.
intro.cn: 这是一个由古老分词变成的纯形容词。

latinIntro.en: The root is Germanic, not Latin; shame and ashamed are native words.
latinIntro.cn: 词根是日耳曼语而非拉丁语，shame 与 ashamed 都是本族词。

definition_zh: 在旁边；到一边；撇开；旁白
definition_en: to one side, away from the main subject, or a short remark not meant for everyone
core_image: 把东西往旁边轻轻一推
scene: 人群从中间分开，让出一条路。He stepped aside to let the cart pass.
sceneCN: 这里 aside 是「到一边」（第 1 个义项：离开原来的位置或路线）；句意是他让到一边，让推车过去。

derivatives.zh: 名词：边；侧面，是 aside 的词根

senses.title: To one side
senses.definition: out of the main path or position
senses.definitionCN: 离开主要的路线或位置
senses.example: He stepped aside to let the cart pass.
senses.exampleCN: 他让到一边，让推车过去。
senses.why: Aside is a- 'on' plus side, so it marks the position at the side of something.
senses.whyCN: aside 由 a-「在」与 side「边」构成，标出的就是某物侧边的位置。

senses.title: Leaving a subject out
senses.definition: setting a matter apart from the main discussion
senses.definitionCN: 把某件事从主要讨论中分出去
senses.example: Aside from the noise, the flat is comfortable.
senses.exampleCN: 除了噪音，这套公寓住着挺舒服。
senses.why: What is moved to the side of a conversation is set apart from it, which gives the excluding sense.
senses.whyCN: 被移到谈话侧边的内容，也就被排除在谈话之外，于是产生「除开」义。

senses.title: A remark for a few ears
senses.definition: a short comment spoken to one person or to the audience
senses.definitionCN: 只对一个人或观众说的简短评论
senses.example: The actor delivered a funny aside to the audience.
senses.exampleCN: 演员对观众说了一句好笑的旁白。
senses.why: Stage speech turned toward the side is heard by the audience alone, so the direction became the name of the line.
senses.whyCN: 舞台上转向侧边说出的台词只有观众听见，于是方向成了这种台词的名称。

intro.en: Aside is a native compound of on and side.
intro.cn: aside 是 on 与 side 构成的本族复合词。

items.en: side meant 'flank, side'.
items.cn: side 意为「侧面、胁」。

items.en: The prefix a- meant 'on, at'.
items.cn: 前缀 a- 意为「在」。

items.en: aside meant 'on one side'.
items.cn: aside 意为「在一侧」。

items.en: The theatre gave it the sense of a private remark.
items.cn: 戏剧赋予它「私下插话」义。

items.en: Aside from became a common way to exclude.
items.cn: aside from 成为常见的排除说法。

note.en: The look-alike group is the side family; the near-meaning group gives apart, besides, and sideways.
note.cn: 形近组是 side 词族；近义组给出 apart、besides 与 sideways。

normalIntro.en: Aside puts a thing at the side of the main line.
normalIntro.cn: aside 就是把东西放到主线的侧边。

normal.en: Set aside means to save or to ignore.
normal.cn: set aside 意为留出或搁置。

normal.en: Aside from introduces an exception.
normal.cn: aside from 引出例外。

normal.en: On stage, an aside is heard by the audience.
normal.cn: 舞台上，旁白是给观众听的。

normal.en: The noun plural is asides.
normal.cn: 名词复数是 asides。

normal.en: Stress the second syllable: a-SIDE.
normal.cn: 重音在第二个音节：a-SIDE。

abstract.en: See a chair pulled out of a row.
abstract.cn: 想象一把椅子被拉出队列。

abstract.en: See a hand waving a topic away.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手把话题挥开。

abstract.en: See an actor turning to whisper outward.
abstract.cn: 想象演员转身向外低语。

examples.en: He stepped aside to let the cart pass.
examples.cn: 他让到一边，让推车过去。

examples.en: Aside from the noise, the flat is comfortable.
examples.cn: 除了噪音，这套公寓住着挺舒服。

examples.en: The actor delivered a funny aside to the audience.
examples.cn: 演员对观众说了一句好笑的旁白。

dict_mnemonic.text: a-（在）加 side（边）：在一边，就是旁边；把话题放到一边，就是撇开。

root: 由 a-「在」与 side「边」构成；先指空间上的「在一侧」，再引申为把话题排除在外，戏剧中又指只说给观众听的旁白。

sensesIntro.en: A place at the side, a topic pushed to the side, and a line spoken to the side.
sensesIntro.cn: 侧边的位置、被推到一边的话题、转向侧边说的话。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand nudging something out of the centre.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手把东西轻推到中线之外。

intro.en: A compound adverb that later became a noun in the theatre.
intro.cn: 这是一个复合副词，后来在戏剧里又成了名词。

latinIntro.en: The root side is Germanic; aside has no Latin element.
latinIntro.cn: 词根 side 属日耳曼语，aside 没有拉丁成分。

definition_zh: 问；询问；请求；要求；邀请；要价
definition_en: to put a question, to request something, to invite someone, or to name a price
core_image: 一个人张开嘴，把问题递到对方面前
scene: 他在柜台前站了一会儿，终于开口。She asked the assistant where the lift was.
sceneCN: 这里 ask 是「询问」（第 1 个义项：提出问题以求回答）；句意是她问店员电梯在哪里。

derivatives.zh: 名词：请求；要价（如 asking price）

senses.title: To put a question
senses.definition: to say something in order to get an answer
senses.definitionCN: 为得到回答而说出某个问题
senses.example: She asked the assistant where the lift was.
senses.exampleCN: 她问店员电梯在哪里。
senses.why: Old English ascian meant 'to ask, to inquire', and this has stayed the word's centre.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 ascian 意为「问、打听」，这一直是这个词的核心。

senses.title: To request
senses.definition: to say that one wants something done or given
senses.definitionCN: 说出希望某事被做或被给予
senses.example: He asked for a glass of water.
senses.exampleCN: 他要了一杯水。
senses.why: A request is a question about another person's will, so the same verb covers both.
senses.whyCN: 请求本质上是在探问对方的意愿，所以同一个动词兼指两者。

senses.title: To invite
senses.definition: to tell someone you would like them to come
senses.definitionCN: 告诉某人你希望他来
senses.example: They asked us to dinner on Friday.
senses.exampleCN: 他们请我们周五去吃晚饭。
senses.why: An invitation asks whether a person will come, which is why ask alone can mean invite.
senses.whyCN: 邀请就是在问对方是否愿意来，所以单用 ask 也能表示邀请。

senses.title: To name a price
senses.definition: to state the amount one wants for something sold
senses.definitionCN: 说出出售某物所希望的价钱
senses.example: They are asking too much for that old car.
senses.exampleCN: 那辆旧车他们要价太高了。
senses.why: A seller's price is a request for money, so the request sense narrows to money in trade.
senses.whyCN: 卖方的价钱就是在索取钱款，于是「请求」义在交易中窄化为「要价」。

intro.en: Ask is an Old English verb of inquiry that has widened into requests and invitations.
intro.cn: ask 是一个表示询问的古英语动词，后来扩展到请求与邀请。

items.en: ascian meant 'to ask, to inquire'.
items.cn: ascian 意为「问、打听」。

items.en: A northern form ahsian existed beside it.
items.cn: 当时还有一个北方形式 ahsian。

items.en: asken kept the question sense and added requesting.
items.cn: asken 保留询问义，并添上请求义。

items.en: Asking someone to dinner meant inviting.
items.cn: 请人吃饭的说法即表示邀请。

items.en: The price sense settled in trade and advertising.
items.cn: 要价义在交易与广告中固定下来。

note.en: The look-alike group is the ask family; the near-meaning group splits questioning, requesting, and inviting.
note.cn: 形近组是 ask 词族；近义组分别对应询问、请求与邀请。

normalIntro.en: Ask covers a question, a favour, an invitation, and a price.
normalIntro.cn: ask 涵盖提问、请求、邀请与要价。

normal.en: Ask for means to request a thing.
normal.cn: ask for 意为索要某物。

normal.en: Ask someone to do means to request an action.
normal.cn: ask someone to do 意为请某人做某事。

normal.en: Ask after someone means to inquire about health.
normal.cn: ask after someone 意为问候健康。

normal.en: The past tense is asked, not askt.
normal.cn: 过去式是 asked，不是 askt。

normal.en: The vowel differs in British and American speech.
normal.cn: 英式与美式发音的元音不同。

abstract.en: See a mouth opening to form a question.
abstract.cn: 想象一张嘴张开准备提问。

abstract.en: See an open palm waiting for something.
abstract.cn: 想象摊开的手掌等着接东西。

abstract.en: See a price tag held up for approval.
abstract.cn: 想象举起价签让人过目。

examples.en: She asked the assistant where the lift was.
examples.cn: 她问店员电梯在哪里。

examples.en: He asked for a glass of water.
examples.cn: 他要了一杯水。

examples.en: They asked us to dinner on Friday.
examples.cn: 他们请我们周五去吃晚饭。

dict_mnemonic.text: ask 的核心是「开口要一个回应」：要答案就是问，要东西就是求，要人来就是请。

root: 源自古英语 ascian「问、打听」，另有北方形式 ahsian；由询问扩展到请求、邀请，再在交易中固定为要价。

sensesIntro.en: One act of speaking toward another person serves for questions, favours, guests, and prices.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一个朝向他人开口的动作，兼用于提问、求助、请客与开价。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a spoken question held out toward another person.
core.cn: 核心意象：一句问话被递到对方面前。

intro.en: A native verb whose derivatives are few and plain.
intro.cn: 这是一个本族动词，派生词少而朴素。

latinIntro.en: The word is Germanic and has no Latin root.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词属日耳曼语，没有拉丁词根。

definition_en: in a state of sleep, or without feeling in a part of the body
core_image: 呼吸放慢，眼皮合上不再动
scene: 客厅的灯还亮着，电视在放旧片。The child was asleep before the film ended.
sceneCN: 这里 asleep 是「睡着的」（第 1 个义项：处于睡眠状态）；句意是电影结束前孩子就睡着了。

collocations.zh: 开车时打瞌睡；疏于职守

senses.title: In a state of sleep
senses.definition: sleeping, with the mind and body at rest
senses.definitionCN: 正在睡觉，身心处于休息状态
senses.example: The child was asleep before the film ended.
senses.exampleCN: 电影结束前孩子就睡着了。
senses.why: Asleep is a- 'on' plus sleep: to be on sleep is to be in that state rather than performing the act.
senses.whyCN: asleep 由 a-「在」与 sleep 构成：处在睡眠之中，强调状态而非动作。

senses.title: Without feeling
senses.definition: numb, of a limb that has lost sensation
senses.definitionCN: 肢体失去知觉
senses.example: My foot was asleep after the long bus ride.
senses.exampleCN: 长途汽车坐久了，我的脚麻了。
senses.why: A numb limb feels dead to the world, so the image of sleep shifts from the whole person to one part.
senses.whyCN: 麻木的肢体对外界毫无感觉，于是「睡」的形象从整个人移到某个部位。

intro.en: Asleep is a native compound of on and sleep.
intro.cn: asleep 是 on 与 sleep 构成的本族复合词。

items.en: slæpan meant 'to sleep'.
items.cn: slæpan 意为「睡觉」。

items.en: slæp was the noun 'sleep'.
items.cn: slæp 是名词「睡眠」。

items.en: The phrase on slepe meant 'in sleep'.
items.cn: 短语 on slepe 意为「在睡眠中」。

items.en: The phrase fused into asleep.
items.cn: 这一短语融合为 asleep。

items.en: The numb-limb sense grew from the idea of deadened feeling.
items.cn: 麻木义由「感觉死寂」的观念发展而来。

note.en: The look-alike group is the sleep family; the near-meaning group gives words for sleeping and numb.
note.cn: 形近组是 sleep 词族；近义组是表示睡着与麻木的词。

normalIntro.en: Asleep describes the state, not the act.
normalIntro.cn: asleep 描述的是状态，而不是动作。

normal.en: It follows the verb to be or to fall.
normal.cn: 它跟在 be 或 fall 之后。

normal.en: Do not say very asleep; say fast asleep.
normal.cn: 不说 very asleep，而说 fast asleep。

normal.en: A sleeping baby, but a baby asleep.
normal.cn: 作定语用 sleeping，作表语用 asleep。

normal.en: A numb foot is described as asleep.
normal.cn: 脚麻了可以用 asleep 形容。

normal.en: Stress the second syllable: a-SLEEP.
normal.cn: 重音在第二个音节：a-SLEEP。

abstract.en: See a chest rising and falling slowly.
abstract.cn: 想象胸口缓缓起伏。

abstract.en: See a handshake that cannot feel the hand.
abstract.cn: 想象一只握不出感觉的手。

abstract.en: See a lamp still on over a still face.
abstract.cn: 想象灯还亮着，脸上却毫无动静。

examples.en: The child was asleep before the film ended.
examples.cn: 电影结束前孩子就睡着了。

examples.en: My foot was asleep after the long bus ride.
examples.cn: 长途汽车坐久了，我的脚麻了。

examples.en: She fell asleep with the book still open.
examples.cn: 书还摊着，她就睡着了。

dict_mnemonic.text: a-（在）加 sleep（睡眠）：处在睡眠状态中，就是睡着的；肢体失去感觉也叫「睡着」。

root: 由古英语短语 on slæpe「在睡眠中」融合而成，a- 表示「在」；由整体睡眠状态引申出肢体麻木义。

sensesIntro.en: A whole body at rest and a limb without feeling share the picture of sleep.
sensesIntro.cn: 整个身体休息与某处肢体失去感觉，共用同一个「睡」的形象。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: closed eyes and slow breathing.
core.cn: 核心意象：合上的眼与放慢的呼吸。

intro.en: A fused phrase that works only as a predicate adjective.
intro.cn: 这是一个融合的短语，只作表语形容词使用。

latinIntro.en: The root sleep is Germanic; there is no Latin element.
latinIntro.cn: 词根 sleep 属日耳曼语，没有拉丁成分。

definition_en: one part of a situation, the look of something, or the direction a place faces
core_image: 同一件东西从不同角度看，显出不同的面
scene: 报告只写了成本，没提对居民的影响。The report ignores the human aspect of the change.
sceneCN: 这里 aspect 是「方面」（第 1 个义项：整体中的一个侧面）；句意是报告忽略了这一变化涉及人的方面。

derivatives.zh: 形容词：方面的；（语法）体的

senses.title: One side of a matter
senses.definition: a particular part of a larger situation or subject
senses.definitionCN: 较大情况或主题中的一个特定部分
senses.example: The report ignores the human aspect of the change.
senses.exampleCN: 报告忽略了这一变化涉及人的方面。
senses.why: Latin aspicere meant 'to look at'; the aspect is what a matter looks like from one direction.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 aspicere 意为「看」；aspect 就是一件事从某个方向看过去的样子。

senses.title: The look of something
senses.definition: the appearance a thing presents
senses.definitionCN: 事物呈现出来的外貌
senses.example: The house took on a gloomy aspect in the rain.
senses.exampleCN: 雨中这房子显得阴沉。
senses.why: Since aspect is what is seen, it can name the visible face of a place or a face itself.
senses.whyCN: 既然 aspect 是被看见的东西，它就能指一个地方或一张面孔可见的样子。

senses.title: The direction something faces
senses.definition: the way a building or slope faces
senses.definitionCN: 建筑物或坡面所朝的方向
senses.example: A southern aspect keeps the garden warm.
senses.exampleCN: 朝南的朝向让花园保持温暖。
senses.why: The direction from which a place is viewed also decides how much light it receives, hence the compass sense.
senses.whyCN: 一个地方被观看的方向也决定它受多少光，于是产生表示方位的用法。

intro.en: Aspect comes from a Latin verb meaning 'to look at'.
intro.cn: aspect 来自一个意为「看」的拉丁动词。

items.en: specere meant 'to look, to see'.
items.cn: specere 意为「看、看见」。

items.en: ad plus specere meant 'to look toward'.
items.cn: ad 与 specere 结合，意为「朝……看」。

items.en: aspectus meant 'a look, an appearance'.
items.cn: aspectus 意为「目光、外观」。

items.en: English aspect first meant the look of a face or sky.
items.cn: 英语 aspect 最初指面孔或天空的样子。

items.en: The word widened to any side of a question.
items.cn: 这个词扩展到问题的任何一个侧面。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the spect root; the near-meaning group gives feature, side, and view.
note.cn: 形近组保留 spect 词根；近义组给出 feature、side 与 view。

normalIntro.en: An aspect is one face of a many-sided thing.
normalIntro.cn: aspect 就是多面之物的一面。

normal.en: An aspect of is the usual pattern.
normal.cn: an aspect of 是最常见的搭配。

normal.en: In grammar, aspect marks how an action unfolds.
normal.cn: 语法里，aspect 表示动作的进行方式。

normal.en: The compas sense survives in estate writing.
normal.cn: 方位义仍见于房产描述文字。

normal.en: The plural is aspects.
normal.cn: 复数是 aspects。

normal.en: Stress the first syllable: AS-pect.
normal.cn: 重音在第一个音节：AS-pect。

abstract.en: See a cube turned to show one face.
abstract.cn: 想象立方体转动，露出一面。

abstract.en: See a window facing south light.
abstract.cn: 想象朝南接光的窗。

abstract.en: See the same event from two balconies.
abstract.cn: 想象从两个阳台看同一件事。

examples.en: The report ignores the human aspect of the change.
examples.cn: 报告忽略了这一变化涉及人的方面。

examples.en: The house took on a gloomy aspect in the rain.
examples.cn: 雨中这房子显得阴沉。

examples.en: A southern aspect keeps the garden warm.
examples.cn: 朝南的朝向让花园保持温暖。

dict_mnemonic.text: a-（向）加 spect（看）：朝某个方向看过去所见的那一面，就是一个方面。

root: 来自拉丁语 aspectus「外观、目光」，源自动词 aspicere「朝……看」，由 ad 与 specere「看」构成；由「所见之面」引申为方面与朝向。

sensesIntro.en: What you see from one side is a face, a look, or a direction.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一侧看见的东西，可以是一面、一种外观，也可以是一个朝向。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a cube turned so one face catches the light.
core.cn: 核心意象：立方体转动，一面接住光。

intro.en: A Latin noun of looking that English turned toward ideas.
intro.cn: 这是一个拉丁语「观看」名词，英语把它转向了抽象观念。

latinIntro.en: The root specere also gives inspect, respect, and spectator.
latinIntro.cn: 词根 specere 也派生出 inspect、respect 与 spectator。

definition_en: to bring people together, or to fit parts together into a whole
core_image: 散落的零件一件件拼合成整体
scene: 操场上哨声一响，各班开始排队。The students assembled in the hall before noon.
sceneCN: 这里 assemble 是「集合」（第 1 个义项：人们聚到一处）；句意是学生们中午前在礼堂集合。

senses.title: To come together in a group
senses.definition: to gather people or to gather oneself in one place
senses.definitionCN: 把人聚到一处，或自身聚到一处
senses.example: The students assembled in the hall before noon.
senses.exampleCN: 学生们中午前在礼堂集合。
senses.why: Old French assembler came from Latin ad simul, 'to the same place', so the word begins as a gathering.
senses.whyCN: 古法语 assembler 来自拉丁语 ad simul「到同一处」，所以这个词本义就是聚集。

senses.title: To fit parts into a whole
senses.definition: to put separate pieces together so they work as one
senses.definitionCN: 把分开的部件拼在一起，使其作为一个整体运作
senses.example: Workers assemble the engines by hand.
senses.exampleCN: 工人们手工组装发动机。
senses.why: If parts are gathered in the right order, the gathering becomes construction; the same verb serves both.
senses.whyCN: 若把零件按正确次序聚到一起，聚集就成了装配；同一个动词兼指两者。

intro.en: Assemble goes back to a Latin phrase meaning 'to the same place'.
intro.cn: assemble 可追溯到意为「到同一处」的拉丁短语。

items.en: simul meant 'together, at the same time'.
items.cn: simul 意为「一起、同时」。

items.en: ad simul meant 'to the same place'.
items.cn: ad simul 意为「到同一处」。

items.en: assembler meant 'to gather together'.
items.cn: assembler 意为「聚拢」。

items.en: English assemble first meant to gather people.
items.cn: 英语 assemble 最初指聚集人群。

items.en: Industry gave it the sense of fitting parts.
items.cn: 工业赋予了它「拼装部件」义。

note.en: The look-alike group is the assembly family; the near-meaning group splits gathering from building.
note.cn: 形近组是 assembly 词族；近义组把聚集与建造分开。

entries.definition: a gathering or a putting together

normalIntro.en: Assemble gathers either people or parts.
normalIntro.cn: assemble 聚拢的要么是人，要么是零件。

normal.en: On a factory line, parts are assembled.
normal.cn: 流水线上组装的是零件。

normal.en: At school, students assemble for a meeting.
normal.cn: 学校里学生集合开会。

normal.en: The noun is assembly.
normal.cn: 名词是 assembly。

normal.en: The stress falls on the second syllable.
normal.cn: 重音落在第二个音节。

normal.en: The word has a silent final e before -ed.
normal.cn: 加 -ed 时词尾的 e 被省去。

abstract.en: See bolts being turned into a frame.
abstract.cn: 想象螺栓被拧进框架。

abstract.en: See rows of students filling a hall.
abstract.cn: 想象学生成排填满礼堂。

abstract.en: See a box of parts emptied on a table.
abstract.cn: 想象一盒零件倒在桌上。

examples.en: The students assembled in the hall before noon.
examples.cn: 学生们中午前在礼堂集合。

examples.en: Workers assemble the engines by hand.
examples.cn: 工人们手工组装发动机。

examples.en: The desk came fully assembled.
examples.cn: 这张桌子送来时已组装完毕。

dict_mnemonic.text: as-（向）加 sembl（一起）：往一处凑，人凑齐是集合，零件凑齐是组装。

root: 源自古法语 assembler「聚拢」，上溯拉丁语 ad simul「到同一处」；由人群聚集引申为部件装配。

sensesIntro.en: Gathering is the root, and parts gathered in order become a machine.
sensesIntro.cn: 聚集是词根；零件按序聚齐，就成了机器。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: separate pieces drawn into one shape.
core.cn: 核心意象：分开的部件被收进同一个形状。

intro.en: A French verb of gathering that industry made technical.
intro.cn: 这是一个法语「聚集」动词，工业使它带上了技术含义。

latinIntro.en: The root simul, 'together', also gives similar and simultaneous.
latinIntro.cn: 词根 simul「一起」也派生出 similar 与 simultaneous。

definition_en: a meeting of many people, the fitting together of parts, or a law-making body
core_image: 大厅里人群坐满，或零件排成一列装上
scene: 周一早晨全校都到操场上站好。The whole school attends assembly on Monday.
sceneCN: 这里 assembly 是「集会」（第 1 个义项：多人聚集的场合）；句意是全校周一都参加集会。

senses.title: A gathering of people
senses.definition: a meeting of a group for a shared purpose
senses.definitionCN: 一群人为共同目的而举行的会面
senses.example: The whole school attends assembly on Monday.
senses.exampleCN: 全校周一都参加集会。
senses.why: The noun of assemble names the gathering itself: what has been brought together is an assembly.
senses.whyCN: assemble 的名词指聚集这件事本身：被聚到一起的，就是 assembly。

senses.title: The fitting of parts
senses.definition: the process of putting components together
senses.definitionCN: 把各个部件拼合起来的过程
senses.example: The engine is built on a moving assembly line.
senses.exampleCN: 发动机在移动的装配线上制造。
senses.why: Since the verb covers fitting parts, the noun names that industrial process too.
senses.whyCN: 既然动词涵盖拼装零件，名词自然也指这一工业过程。

senses.title: A law-making body
senses.definition: an elected group that makes laws
senses.definitionCN: 制定法律的民选团体
senses.example: The regional assembly passed the measure by one vote.
senses.exampleCN: 地区议会以一票之差通过了这项措施。
senses.why: A body of elected members is literally an assembly, and the name became the title of the institution.
senses.whyCN: 民选成员组成的团体字面上就是一次集会，这个名字随后成了机构名称。

intro.en: Assembly is the noun of the French verb for gathering.
intro.cn: assembly 是法语中表示聚集的动词所对应的名词。

items.en: The phrase meant 'to the same place'.
items.cn: 这一短语意为「到同一处」。

items.en: assembler meant 'to gather'.
items.cn: assembler 意为「聚集」。

items.en: assemblee meant 'a gathering'.
items.cn: assemblee 意为「集会」。

items.en: Assembly named both meetings and law-making bodies.
items.cn: assembly 兼指会议与立法机构。

items.en: Industry added the sense of fitting parts together.
items.cn: 工业又添上「拼装部件」义。

note.en: The look-alike group is the assemble family; the near-meaning group gives meeting, production, and parliament.
note.cn: 形近组是 assemble 词族；近义组给出会议、生产与议会。

normalIntro.en: Assembly is both the meeting and the making.
normalIntro.cn: assembly 既是聚会，也是拼装。

normal.en: School assembly gathers everyone in one hall.
normal.cn: school assembly 把全校聚到一个礼堂。

normal.en: An assembly line moves work past workers.
normal.cn: assembly line 让工作依次经过工人。

normal.en: Freedom of assembly protects public meetings.
normal.cn: freedom of assembly 保护公开集会。

normal.en: The plural changes y to ies.
normal.cn: 复数把 y 变 i 再加 es。

normal.en: Stress the second syllable: a-SSEM-bly.
normal.cn: 重音在第二个音节：a-SSEM-bly。

abstract.en: See a hall filling with seated people.
abstract.cn: 想象礼堂坐满了人。

abstract.en: See parts moving along a belt.
abstract.cn: 想象零件沿传送带移动。

abstract.en: See a raised hand voting in a chamber.
abstract.cn: 想象议事厅里举起表决的手。

examples.en: The whole school attends assembly on Monday.
examples.cn: 全校周一都参加集会。

examples.en: The engine is built on a moving assembly line.
examples.cn: 发动机在移动的装配线上制造。

examples.en: The regional assembly passed the measure by one vote.
examples.cn: 地区议会以一票之差通过了这项措施。

dict_mnemonic.text: assemble（聚集）加 -y：聚起来的一群人叫集会，聚起来的一堆零件叫装配。

root: 源自古法语 assemblee「集会」，来自动词 assembler「聚集」，上溯拉丁语 ad simul「到同一处」；后扩展出装配与议会义。

sensesIntro.en: People gathered make a meeting, parts gathered make a product, and members gathered make a parliament.
sensesIntro.cn: 人聚起来是会议，零件聚起来是产品，议员聚起来是议会。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hall of people, or a row of parts, brought into one place.
core.cn: 核心意象：一屋子人或一排零件被收进同一处。

intro.en: A noun that moves easily between people and machines.
intro.cn: 这是一个在人、机器之间自由切换的名词。

latinIntro.en: The root simul, 'together', also gives similar and simultaneous.
latinIntro.cn: 词根 simul「一起」也派生出 similar 与 simultaneous。

definition_en: to judge the value or quality of something, or to set a tax on it
core_image: 法官身旁有人翻着卷宗，为每件事标出分量
scene: 保险公司派人来看被水泡过的墙。An engineer came to assess the damage.
sceneCN: 这里 assess 是「评估」（第 1 个义项：判断情况的性质与程度）；句意是工程师来评估损失程度。

pos.zh: 动词：评估；估算；核定（税额）

senses.title: Judge value or quality
senses.definition: to judge or decide the amount, value or quality of something
senses.definitionCN: 判断某事的数量、价值或好坏
senses.example: An engineer came to assess the damage.
senses.exampleCN: 一位工程师来评估损失。
senses.why: Assess comes from Latin assidere 'to sit beside', originally of an assistant sitting next to a judge, so the core act is sitting down to weigh a case.
senses.whyCN: assess 源自拉丁语 assidere「坐在旁边」，原指坐在法官身旁协助断案，核心动作就是坐下来衡量一桩事情。

senses.title: Set a tax or fine
senses.definition: to calculate and set the amount of a tax or fine to be paid
senses.definitionCN: 计算并确定应缴的税额或罚款
senses.example: The city assesses a tax on every rented flat.
senses.exampleCN: 市里对每套出租房征税。
senses.why: The act of weighing value entered the treasury: once a property's worth is judged, a tax can be fixed on it, and that fixing became a sense of its own.
senses.whyCN: 衡量价值的动作进入财政领域：先判定财产值多少，再据此定税，这个「定额」的环节单独成了一个义项。

intro.en: Assess began as a word about sitting beside a judge and ended as a word about weighing value.
intro.cn: assess 起初指坐在法官身旁，最后变成衡量价值的词。

items.en: assidere meant 'to sit beside', used of a judge's assistant.
items.cn: assidere 意为「坐在旁边」，用于说法官的助手。

items.en: assessus was the one who sat beside and helped fix a penalty.
items.cn: assessus 指坐在旁边协助定罚的人。

items.en: assessare meant 'to fix the amount of a tax'.
items.cn: assessare 意为「核定税额」。

items.en: English assessen kept the tax sense, valuing property for payment.
items.cn: 英语 assessen 保留税务义，为征税而估定财产价值。

items.en: The sense widened from tax to any judgement of value or quality.
items.cn: 词义从税务扩大到对任何事物的价值与质量作出判断。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the assess shape; the near-meaning group gives other verbs of judging value.
note.cn: 形近组与 assess 外形相近；近义组是其他表示估值的动词。

normalIntro.en: Think of the assessor who sits beside the judge and writes down a figure.
normalIntro.cn: 想象估税员坐在法官身旁，写下一个数字。

normal.en: The double s belongs to the stem: as-sess, not a-sess.
normal.cn: 词干里是双 s：as-sess，不要写成单 s。

normal.en: It takes a direct object: assess the damage, assess the risk.
normal.cn: 它直接带宾语：评估损失、评估风险。

normal.en: The noun keeps the double s: assessment.
normal.cn: 名词拼作 assessment，中间保留双 s。

normal.en: Use it when a judgement needs evidence, not for a quick guess.
normal.cn: 需要依据作出判断时用它，随口一猜不用它。

normal.en: In tax talk it means to fix a sum, not to collect it.
normal.cn: 在税务语境里指核定金额，而不是收取。

abstract.en: See a hand weighing a folder on a brass scale.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手把卷宗放上铜天平称量。

abstract.en: See a stamp pressed onto a property list, fixing a figure.
abstract.cn: 想象印章压在房产清单上，定下一个数目。

abstract.en: See a doctor reading a chart before speaking.
abstract.cn: 想象医生先看完病历再开口。

examples.en: An engineer came to assess the damage.
examples.cn: 一位工程师来评估损失。

examples.en: The city assesses a tax on every rented flat.
examples.cn: 市里对每套出租房征税。

examples.en: Teachers assess students on both writing and speaking.
examples.cn: 老师从写作和口语两方面评估学生。

dict_mnemonic.text: as-（在旁）加 sess（坐）：坐在旁边替人衡量，就是评估；衡量财产以定税，就是核定税额。

root: 源自拉丁语 assidere「坐在旁边」，经中世纪拉丁语 assessare「核定税额」进入英语，由「坐在法官身旁断案」引申为评估，再专指核定税额。

sensesIntro.en: Weighing a situation and fixing a tax are two stages of the same seated judgement.
sensesIntro.cn: 衡量情况与核定税额，是同一个「坐下来判断」的两个阶段。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a figure written beside a case after it has been weighed.
core.cn: 核心意象：一桩事情称量过后，旁边写下一个数字。

branches.en: the flat was assessed at a high figure
branches.cn: 这套房被估定为一个高数额

intro.en: Assess is built on the Latin verb for sitting, and the same root runs through session and preside.
intro.cn: assess 建立在拉丁语「坐」的动词上，同一词根贯穿 session 与 preside。

latinIntro.en: The root sess or sid, 'to sit', comes from Latin sedere.
latinIntro.cn: 词根 sess 或 sid 意为「坐」，来自拉丁语 sedere。

definition_en: something valuable that a person or company owns, or a useful quality
core_image: 账本左栏一件件能换成钱的东西
scene: 公司最值钱的不是机器，而是那批老客户。Her calm voice is a great asset in court.
sceneCN: 这里 asset 是「优势」（第 2 个义项：能带来好处的人或特质）；句意是她在法庭上沉稳的嗓音是一大优势。

senses.title: Property of value
senses.definition: something of value owned by a person or a company
senses.definitionCN: 个人或公司拥有的、有价之物
senses.example: The company sold several assets to pay its debts.
senses.exampleCN: 公司卖掉几项资产来还债。
senses.why: Asset comes from Norman French asetz, 'enough to settle a debt', so the word began as property counted for its ability to pay.
senses.whyCN: asset 来自诺曼法语 asetz，原指「足以清偿债务的财产」，所以这个词一开始就是按「能抵债」来计量的财物。

senses.title: Useful quality or person
senses.definition: a person or quality that is useful and brings benefit
senses.definitionCN: 有用、能带来好处的人或特质
senses.example: Her calm voice is a great asset in court.
senses.exampleCN: 她在法庭上沉稳的嗓音是一大优势。
senses.why: Once anything that can pay off is counted as an asset, the step to a helpful person or trait is short: both are reckoned by the benefit they bring.
senses.whyCN: 凡是能抵用、能带来回报的东西都被算作资产，再向前一步，能帮上忙的人或特质也就成了资产，衡量标准都是「带来多少好处」。

intro.en: Asset is a Norman French word about having enough, and English turned it into a noun for property.
intro.cn: asset 是来自诺曼法语的词，本义与「足够」有关，英语把它变成表示财产的名词。

items.en: ad satis meant 'to enough', enough to meet a claim.
items.cn: ad satis 意为「达到足够」，即足以应付索偿。

items.en: asez meant 'enough, sufficiency of wealth'.
items.cn: asez 意为「足够、财富充裕」。

items.en: asetz named the property left by a debtor, enough to pay.
items.cn: asetz 指债务人留下的、足以偿债的财产。

items.en: English took assets as a plural noun for property and funds.
items.cn: 英语以复数形式 assets 借入，指财产与资金。

items.en: The sense widened to any valuable quality or helpful person.
items.cn: 词义扩大，凡有价值的特质或能帮忙的人也算资产。

note.en: The look-alike group is spelled like asset; the near-meaning group names property and advantage.
note.cn: 形近组拼写与 asset 相近；近义组是表示财产与优势的词。

normalIntro.en: An asset is whatever can be counted on the left side of the ledger.
normalIntro.cn: 资产就是账本左栏里能数得出来的东西。

normal.en: The plural is far more common in finance: assets.
normal.cn: 在财务语境里复数形式更常见。

normal.en: It is a countable noun: a great asset, several assets.
normal.cn: 它是可数名词：一大优势、几项资产。

normal.en: One t in the middle, and stress falls on the first syllable: AS-set.
normal.cn: 中间只有一个 t，重音在第一个音节。

normal.en: The phrase be an asset to praises a person's value.
normal.cn: 短语 be an asset to 用来称赞某人的价值。

normal.en: Do not confuse it with assess, which is the verb.
normal.cn: 不要和动词 assess 混淆。

abstract.en: See a ledger page where each line can be turned into cash.
abstract.cn: 想象账本上每一行都能换成现金。

abstract.en: See a quiet colleague whose presence steadies a whole room.
abstract.cn: 想象一位安静同事，他一来整个屋子就稳住了。

abstract.en: See a key that opens more than one door.
abstract.cn: 想象一把能开不止一扇门的钥匙。

examples.en: The company sold several assets to pay its debts.
examples.cn: 公司卖掉几项资产来还债。

examples.en: Her calm voice is a great asset in court.
examples.cn: 她在法庭上沉稳的嗓音是一大优势。

examples.en: Patience is an asset when you learn a language.
examples.cn: 学语言时，耐心是一种优势。

dict_mnemonic.text: 诺曼法语 asetz 本指「够还债的财产」，进入英语成 assets；从「能抵债的财物」引申为资产，再到「能帮忙的人或特质」。

root: 诺曼法语 asetz 意为「足以偿债的财产」，源自拉丁语 ad satis「达到足够」；由够还债的财物引申为资产，再抽象为能带来好处的优势。

sensesIntro.en: Property counted for what it can pay and a person counted for what they can give share one measure of value.
sensesIntro.cn: 财物按能抵多少债来算，人按能带来多少好处来算，用的是同一把价值尺。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a ledger line that can be turned into cash.
core.cn: 核心意象：账本上一行可以换成现金的条目。

intro.en: Asset is a borrowed whole word, but it sits in a wide field of property and value terms.
intro.cn: asset 是整体借入的词，但它处在一大片表示财产与价值的词场中。

latinIntro.en: Its Latin ancestor ad satis, 'to enough', also underlies satisfy and satiate.
latinIntro.cn: 它的拉丁语祖词 ad satis「达到足够」，也是 satisfy 与 satiate 的来源。

definition_zh: 分配；指派；确定（时间、地点）
definition_en: to give a task or share to someone, or to fix a time, place or right
core_image: 名册上每个名字旁边写着分到的那一份
scene: 编辑部的白板上写着各人负责的栏目。She was assigned to the travel desk.
sceneCN: 这里 assign 是「指派」（第 1 个义项：把任务分给某人）；句意是她被派去负责旅游版。

senses.title: Give a task or share
senses.definition: to give someone a particular job or a share of something
senses.definitionCN: 把某项工作或某一份东西交给某人
senses.example: She was assigned to the travel desk.
senses.exampleCN: 她被派去负责旅游版。
senses.why: Assign comes from Latin assignare 'to mark out', the act of noting on a list that a thing belongs to a certain person, so the sense is a marked allotment.
senses.whyCN: assign 源自拉丁语 assignare「作标记」，原指在名册上标明某物归谁，因此核心是「标好归属的分派」。

senses.title: Fix a time or place
senses.definition: to decide and state a time, place or value
senses.definitionCN: 确定并说明时间、地点或数值
senses.example: The judge assigned a date for the hearing.
senses.exampleCN: 法官确定了听证日期。
senses.why: Marking on a list also served to pin down when and where something happens, so 'allot' extended to fixing a date or place.
senses.whyCN: 在名册上作标记同样用于给日子和地点定位，于是「分派」自然引申为把时间、地点确定下来。

senses.title: Transfer by law
senses.definition: to transfer property or a right to another person in law
senses.definitionCN: 依法把财产或权利转到他人名下
senses.example: He assigned the copyright to the publisher.
senses.exampleCN: 他把版权转让给了出版社。
senses.why: Writing a right under another person's name is the most literal form of the marking act, and law kept that concrete sense as 'transfer'.
senses.whyCN: 把一项权利登记到别人名下，是「作标记」最字面的一种做法，法律保留了这个具体含义，用作「转让」。

intro.en: Assign is a word about marking names, which English uses for tasks, dates and legal rights.
intro.cn: assign 本义是「标记名字」，英语用它来说任务、日期与法律权利。

items.en: signum meant 'a mark or sign'.
items.cn: signum 意为「标记、符号」。

items.en: assignare meant 'to mark out, to allot'.
items.cn: assignare 意为「标出、分派」。

items.en: assigner carried the sense 'to allot or appoint'.
items.cn: assigner 表示「分派、指定」。

items.en: English assignen meant 'to allot or fix'.
items.cn: 英语 assignen 意为「分派、确定」。

items.en: Law added the sense 'to transfer a right or property'.
items.cn: 法律领域增出「转让权利或财产」的义项。

note.en: The look-alike group is the sign family; the near-meaning group gives other verbs of giving out.
note.cn: 形近组是 sign 词族；近义组是其他表示分发的动词。

entries.definition: to give out for a purpose
to give a share to each
to name someone for a post

normalIntro.en: Assign puts a name beside a share, a task or a date.
normalIntro.cn: assign 是在份额、任务或日期旁边写上名字。

normal.en: Ends in silent g: assign, not assin.
normal.cn: 词尾的 g 不发音，别拼成 assin。

normal.en: The noun is assignment: just add -ment to assign.
normal.cn: 名词是 assignment，在 assign 后直接加 -ment。

normal.en: Use assign someone to something for posts, and assign something to someone for shares.
normal.cn: 派岗用 assign someone to something，分物用 assign something to someone。

normal.en: Only one s at the start: as-sign.
normal.cn: 开头只有一个 s：as-sign。

normal.en: In law it means to hand over a right formally.
normal.cn: 在法律里它指正式移交一项权利。

abstract.en: See a teacher writing initials beside each row of desks.
abstract.cn: 想象老师在每排课桌旁写下姓名缩写。

abstract.en: See a calendar square darkened for one hearing.
abstract.cn: 想象日历上有一个格子被涂黑，标着某场听证。

abstract.en: See a deed sliding across a desk into new hands.
abstract.cn: 想象一份契约从桌面滑到另一个人手里。

examples.en: She was assigned to the travel desk.
examples.cn: 她被派去负责旅游版。

examples.en: The judge assigned a date for the hearing.
examples.cn: 法官确定了听证日期。

examples.en: He assigned the copyright to the publisher.
examples.cn: 他把版权转让给了出版社。

dict_mnemonic.text: as-（向）加 sign（记号）：在名册上给某人做记号，就是分派；把日子标出来，就是确定；把权利记到别人名下，就是转让。

root: 源自拉丁语 signum「记号」与 assignare「标出、分派」，经古法语 assigner 进入英语；由「在名册上标明归属」引申为分配与指派，再引申为确定日期和依法转让。

sensesIntro.en: Marking a name on a list can allot a duty, pin a date, or hand over a right.
sensesIntro.cn: 在名册上标一个名字，可以分派职责、定下日期，也可以移交权利。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a name written beside the share it will receive.
core.cn: 核心意象：名字旁边写着它将要分到的那一份。

intro.en: The root sign, 'a mark', runs through assign, design and signal.
intro.cn: 词根 sign 意为「记号」，贯穿 assign、design 与 signal。

latinIntro.en: Signum is Latin for a mark, and its family spread into law, art and language.
latinIntro.cn: signum 是拉丁语「记号」，这一族词进入了法律、艺术与语言领域。

items.meaning: to mark out for a role
